measurement_recipe.python_source:
"""Measure complete real local status/diagnostics paths without granting authority."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import threading
import time

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = BASE / "candidate-v022"
REPEATS = 20


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


input_manifest_path = BASE / "v022-input-sha256.json"
input_manifest_sha256 = sha(input_manifest_path.read_bytes())
source_inputs = json.loads(input_manifest_path.read_text())
for name, expected in source_inputs.items():
    assert sha((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) == expected, "Measured candidate differs from the input inventory: " + name


def stats(values):
    ordered = sorted(values)
    return {"count": len(values), "first": values[0], "minimum": ordered[0],
            "p50": ordered[math.ceil(.50 * len(ordered)) - 1],
            "p95": ordered[math.ceil(.95 * len(ordered)) - 1],
            "p99": ordered[math.ceil(.99 * len(ordered)) - 1], "maximum": ordered[-1]}


def checked_native(stdout):
    value = json.loads(stdout)
    assert value["available"] is True and value["verified"] is True
    assert value["protocolVersion"] == "2025-06-18"
    assert [item["name"] for item in value["tools"]] == ["connection_status"]
    assert "NOT CONNECTED" in value["status"]
    return value


diagnostics_requests = [
    {"id": 1, "method": "capabilities.list"},
    {"id": 2, "method": "system.summary"},
    {"id": 3, "method": "missing.method"},
]
diagnostics_input = ("\n".join(json.dumps(row) for row in diagnostics_requests) + "\n").encode()


def checked_diagnostics(stdout):
    rows = [json.loads(row) for row in stdout.splitlines()]
    assert len(rows) == 3 and [row["id"] for row in rows] == [1, 2, 3]
    assert "result" in rows[0] and "result" in rows[1] and rows[2].get("error")
    assert not {"hostname", "username", "home", "cwd", "environment"}.intersection(rows[1]["result"])
    return rows


def fresh_process(argv, cwd, input_bytes, validate):
    values = []
    output_hashes = set()
    resource_samples = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="v022-benchmark-", dir=BASE) as temporary:
        output_file = Path(temporary) / "stdout"
        error_file = Path(temporary) / "stderr"
        for _ in range(REPEATS):
            with output_file.open("wb") as output, error_file.open("wb") as error:
                started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                process = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=cwd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE if input_bytes is not None else subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=output, stderr=error)
                timed_out = []
                def timeout():
                    timed_out.append(True)
                    process.kill()
                deadline = threading.Timer(10, timeout)
                deadline.start()
                try:
                    if input_bytes is not None:
                        process.stdin.write(input_bytes)
                        process.stdin.close()
                    _, status, usage = os.wait4(process.pid, 0)
                    process.returncode = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
                    elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1_000_000
                    assert not timed_out, "Measured process timed out"
                finally:
                    deadline.cancel()
                    if process.returncode is None:
                        process.kill()
                        process.wait(timeout=5)
                assert process.returncode == 0, error_file.read_text(errors="replace")[:500]
            checked = validate(output_file.read_bytes())
            output_hashes.add(sha(json.dumps(checked, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()))
            values.append(elapsed_ms)
            resource_samples.append({"user_cpu_seconds": usage.ru_utime, "system_cpu_seconds": usage.ru_stime, "max_rss_kib": usage.ru_maxrss})
    assert len(output_hashes) == 1, "Complete semantic results varied across equivalent repeated inputs"
    return {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(cwd.relative_to(ROOT)) or ".", "wall_ms": stats(values),
            "samples_ms": values, "semantic_result_sha256": next(iter(output_hashes)),
            "all_results_validated": True, "resource_samples": resource_samples}


assert shutil.which("node") and hasattr(os, "wait4") and platform.system() == "Linux"
native = fresh_process(["node", "tools/computer-link/run.mjs", "mcp-status"], ROOT, None, checked_native)
diagnostics = fresh_process(["python3", "-m", "computer_link"], ROOT / "computer-link", diagnostics_input, checked_diagnostics)

warm_script = """
import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { getComputerLinkMcpStatus, getComputerLinkStatus } from './desktop/src/computer-link.mjs';
const samples=[],hashes=new Set();
const canonical=value=>Array.isArray(value)?value.map(canonical):value&&typeof value==='object'?Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(value).sort().map(key=>[key,canonical(value[key])])):value;
for(let i=0;i<20;i++){
  const before=performance.now(),value=await getComputerLinkMcpStatus();
  samples.push(performance.now()-before);
  if(!value.verified||value.protocolVersion!=='2025-06-18'||value.tools.length!==1||value.tools[0].name!=='connection_status'||!value.status.includes('NOT CONNECTED'))throw new Error('Native status failed');
  hashes.add(createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(canonical(value))).digest('hex'));
}
if(hashes.size!==1||(await getComputerLinkStatus()).owner.running)throw new Error('Result changed or owner authority started');
console.log(JSON.stringify({samples,semanticHash:[...hashes][0],ownerStarted:false}));
"""
warm_run = subprocess.run(["node", "--input-type=module"], input=warm_script.encode(), cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, timeout=10)
assert warm_run.returncode == 0, warm_run.stderr.decode(errors="replace")[:500]
warm_native = json.loads(warm_run.stdout)
assert warm_native["semanticHash"] == native["semantic_result_sha256"], "Fresh and initialized adapter returned different complete semantic results"

process = subprocess.Popen(["python3", "-m", "computer_link"], cwd=ROOT / "computer-link", stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
deadline = threading.Timer(10, process.kill)
deadline.start()
warm_python = []
try:
    for _ in range(REPEATS + 1):
        started = time.perf_counter_ns()
        process.stdin.write(diagnostics_input)
        process.stdin.flush()
        output = b"".join(process.stdout.readline() for _ in range(3))
        warm_python.append((time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1_000_000)
        rows = checked_diagnostics(output)
        assert sha(json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()) == diagnostics["semantic_result_sha256"], "Fresh and existing Python processes returned different complete semantic results"
    process.stdin.close()
    exit_started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    assert process.wait(timeout=5) == 0
    warm_python_exit = (time.perf_counter_ns() - exit_started) / 1_000_000
    assert not process.stderr.read()
finally:
    deadline.cancel()
    if process.poll() is None:
        process.kill()
        process.wait(timeout=5)

binary = ROOT / "build/computer-link/host/computer-link-mcp-session"
binary_manifest_path = binary.parent / "BUILD-MANIFEST.json"
binary_manifest = json.loads(binary_manifest_path.read_text())
result = {
    "schema": "constellation-022-runtime-measurement-v1",
    "assessed_source_manifest_sha256": input_manifest_sha256,
    "environment": {"os": platform.system(), "kernel": platform.release(), "architecture": platform.machine(),
                    "logical_cpus": os.cpu_count(), "node": subprocess.check_output(["node", "--version"], text=True).strip(),
                    "python": platform.python_version(), "rustc_on_measurement_path": subprocess.check_output(["rustc", "--version"], text=True).strip() if shutil.which("rustc") else None},
    "binary_sha256": sha(binary.read_bytes()), "binary_bytes": binary.stat().st_size,
    "native_build_manifest": {"sha256": sha(binary_manifest_path.read_bytes()), "target": binary_manifest["target"], "source_commit": binary_manifest["sourceCommit"], "constellation_commit": binary_manifest.get("constellationCommit"), "compiled_source_fingerprint": binary_manifest.get("sourceFingerprint")},
    "measurement_script_sha256": sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
    "workload": {"native": "Actual adapter discovery, child creation, MCP initialization/readiness/tool discovery/status, validation and native child EOF; no owner grant.",
                 "diagnostics": diagnostics_requests, "diagnostics_input_sha256": sha(diagnostics_input)},
    "fresh_process_native_status": native,
    "fresh_process_python_diagnostics": diagnostics,
    "warm_initialized_node_adapter": {"wall_ms": stats(warm_native["samples"]), "samples_ms": warm_native["samples"],
                                      "semantic_result_sha256": warm_native["semanticHash"], "owner_started": warm_native["ownerStarted"],
                                      "scope": "Existing Node module; every measured operation still creates and fully closes a fresh native MCP process."},
    "warm_existing_python_session": {"first_reply_after_spawn_ms": warm_python[0], "reply_complete_ms": stats(warm_python[1:]), "samples_ms": warm_python[1:],
                                     "final_eof_exit_ms": warm_python_exit,
                                     "scope": "Actual supported JSON-lines process; identical complete three-request batches. Initial reply and final process exit measured separately, no discarded work."},
    "limitations": ["Shared Linux executor measurement, not Windows installation, GUI, physical input or browser acceptance.",
                    "Fresh-process launch includes normal initialization; OS filesystem/page cache was uncontrolled and never flushed or prewarmed deliberately.",
                    "Exact source bytes were verified before measurement, and ordinary copying/earlier builds may populate the OS page cache. These are fresh-process measurements, not cold-cache hardware starts.",
                    "Twenty samples provide descriptive nearest-rank percentiles; p99 is not a statistically established service-level bound.",
                    "Linux wait4 child resource values are recorded as reported; peak RSS is not a simultaneous aggregate of all processes. No GNU time dependency or synthetic replacement workload is used.",
                    "No alternative optimization was retained and no before/after speedup is claimed."],
}
assert sha(input_manifest_path.read_bytes()) == input_manifest_sha256, "Assessment inventory changed during measurement"
(BASE / "v022-runtime-measurements.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"native_fresh_ms": native["wall_ms"], "python_fresh_ms": diagnostics["wall_ms"],
                  "native_warm_ms": result["warm_initialized_node_adapter"]["wall_ms"],
                  "python_warm_ms": result["warm_existing_python_session"]["reply_complete_ms"]}))
